newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Commercial Mexicana raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Commercial Mexicana raised to buy.

text.p: -- ING Barings said it is upgrading its rating on Mexican retailer Commercial Mexicana to a buy from a hold.

-- ING Barings Mexico retail analyst Sebastian Barry Taylor said that Comerci has a target price of $1.10 for year-end 1997, giving the stock an expected annualized appreciation of 20.4 percent, with most price appreciation expected in the second half of 1997.
-- "Longstanding investor concerns regarding the company's high dollar debt and sluggish new unit growth have been largely removed," he wrote.
- Barings said that Comerci's balance sheet has improved following its $70 million equity placement in October.
